body.statement: For any kernel \(K\), integral operator \(L_K\), score \(s_p\), and exponent \(r\), Zhou, Shi, and Zhu's nonparametric score-estimation assumptions B.1--B.5 require an open domain with piecewise-C1 boundary, continuously differentiable density, log density, and kernel, the stated diagonal-kernel density boundary/tail condition, a Bernstein-type exponential condition on the centered RKHS-valued kernel-divergence feature \(\xi_x=\operatorname{div}_xK_x^\top\), and a uniformly bounded kernel diagonal. Their supplement explicitly permits uniform boundedness of \(\|\xi_x-\mathbb E\xi_x\|_{\mathcal H_K}\) as a stronger replacement for B.4. Theorem B.1 separately imposes \(s_p=L_K^rf_0\), with \(r\) no larger than the regularizer qualification.

source.locator: Supplement, Appendix B, Assumptions B.1--B.5 and Theorem B.1, pp. 2--3
source.verbatim_statement: Note that Assumption B.4 can be replaced by a stronger one that ‖ξₓ − ξ‖_H_K is uniformly bounded on X.
